deep.reconstruction:
Context: Grothendieck is building a theory of singular numbers (generalized s-numbers) for operators in a von Neumann algebra with a faithful normal semifinite trace Tr. For an operator A, φ_{|A|}(t) is the decreasing rearrangement (t-th singular number) of |A| on ]0, Tr(1)[. Φ_{|A|}(t) = ∫_0^t φ_{|A|}(s) ds is the Ky Fan functional. Δ is a multiplicative, determinant-type functional (Δ_{fg} = Δ_f Δ_g). The previous page states Th.1, Δ_{|AB|} ≤ Δ_{|A||B|}, which is a Horn/Weyl log-majorization. It also states Th.2: W(AB) ≤ W(φ_{|A|}φ_{|B|}) for increasing 'Weyl functions' W. Corollary 1 there gives the weak majorization ∫_0^t φ_{|AB|} ≤ ∫_0^t φ_{|A|}φ_{|B|} and |Tr AB| ≤ ∫ φ_{|A|}φ_{|B|}.

This page draws further corollaries.

(i) With p, q, r > 0 and 1/p + 1/q = 1/r, take W(f) = ∫|f|^r, so that W(A) = Tr|A|^r. Th.2 then gives Tr|AB|^r ≤ ∫(φ_{|A|}φ_{|B|})^r, i.e. ||AB||_r ≤ ||φ_{|A|}φ_{|B|}||_r. Classical Hölder for functions on the half-line then yields Corollary 2, the operator Hölder inequality (6): ||AB||_r ≤ ||A||_p ||B||_q.

(ii) Corollary 3 is the Ky Fan variational formula (7): Φ_{|A|}(t) = sup |Tr BA| over B with ||B|| ≤ 1 and Tr(support of B) ≤ t.
- Φ ≤ sup: write the polar decomposition A = U|A|. Choose a projection E with Tr E = t and Tr E|A| = Φ_{|A|}(t). Then B = EU* has norm ≤ 1, support trace ≤ t, and |Tr EU*A| = Φ_{|A|}(t).
- sup ≤ Φ: let E = σ(B) be the support projection. Then φ_{|B|} = φ_{|BE|} ≤ ||B|| φ_E ≤ φ_E (via Cor. 2 of the next page's Prop. 1). Using (5), |Tr BA| ≤ ∫ φ_E φ_{|A|} = ∫_0^t φ_{|A|} = Φ_{|A|}(t).

(iii) Corollary 4: A ↦ Φ_{|A|}(t) is a supremum of the seminorms |Tr BA|, hence convex and subadditive. This gives (8): Φ_{|A+B|} ≤ Φ_{|A|} + Φ_{|B|}, the triangle inequality for the Ky Fan norms.

The purpose is to set up the classical trace-ideal inequalities (Hölder, Ky Fan, majorization) in semifinite von Neumann algebras. This is the material of Grothendieck's Séminaire Bourbaki exposé on rearrangements and convexity inequalities in von Neumann algebras with trace.
errors: The '≤' direction assumes a projection E with Tr E = t exactly and Tr E|A| = Φ_{|A|}(t). In a general (e.g. atomic or type I) algebra, t need not lie in the range of the trace on projections, and the supremum need not be attained without a spectral-projection argument. Some approximation or a non-atomic reduction is needed; this is not addressed on the page.
φ_{|B|} = φ_{|EB|} with E = σ(B) requires the correct side, left versus right support (B = Bσ_r(B) or B = σ_l(B)B). The notation is loose but harmless.

For r < 1, ∫|f|^r is not convex in f. The use of Th.2 is legitimate only because Th.1 is a multiplicative (log-)majorization; t ↦ e^{rt} is convex, so t^r is a Weyl function in the log sense. This dependence is implicit on the page. Also, ||·||_r is only a quasi-norm for r < 1.

ideas.what: Operator Hölder inequality ||AB||_r ≤ ||A||_p ||B||_q for all p, q, r > 0 in a semifinite von Neumann algebra, derived from log-majorization of singular numbers
ideas.modern_name: Hölder inequality for noncommutative L^p spaces / generalized s-numbers
ideas.usually_credited_to: Dixmier (1953) for p, q ≥ 1; Fack–Kosaki (1986) for the s-number approach with all r > 0
ideas.where_published: Séminaire Bourbaki exposé 113 (1955), 'Réarrangements de fonctions et inégalités de convexité dans les algèbres de von Neumann munies d'une trace'

ideas.what: Ky Fan variational formula Φ_{|A|}(t) = sup{|Tr BA| : ||B|| ≤ 1, Tr σ(B) ≤ t}
ideas.modern_name: Ky Fan maximum principle for generalized singular numbers
ideas.usually_credited_to: Ky Fan (1951) for matrices; Fack (1982) and Fack–Kosaki (1986) for von Neumann algebras
ideas.where_published: Probably in the Bourbaki exposé 113 (1955), at least in statement

ideas.modern_name: Triangle inequality for Ky Fan norms / submajorization of μ(A+B)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Ky Fan; Fack–Kosaki (1986, Thm 4.4) for the von Neumann algebra setting

missed.claim: The page is a working draft, with proofs, of the semifinite-von-Neumann-algebra s-number inequalities: Hölder for all r > 0 via Horn-type log-majorization, the Ky Fan formula, and Ky Fan subadditivity. This is about 30 years before the standard Fack–Kosaki treatment. The results themselves are known; the novelty is only the documented 1953 priority and proof route.

missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is mainly historical attribution in noncommutative integration. It is largely covered by Grothendieck's own Bourbaki exposé, so there is little new content.

deep.surprise_reason: The material is standard today (Fack–Kosaki 1986) and was largely announced in Grothendieck's 1955 Bourbaki exposé. The interest is the early, complete proof sketches, including the Ky Fan formula and Hölder for all r > 0 via log-majorization, but nothing appears absent from the literature.
transcription_corrections: 'Tr(σ(EU*))' — σ denotes the support projection, consistent with 'E = σ(B)' below.
Line 1 likely reads 'Soient p, q, r > 0 tels que 1/p + 1/q = 1/r, r → ...'; the trailing words are illegible.
The line before Corollary 2 probably reads 'd'où, en appliquant l'inégalité de Hölder classique'.
'φ_{|B|} = φ_{|EB|} (où E = σ(B)) ≤ ‖B‖ φ_{|E|} = φ_{|E|}' — the last equality uses ‖B‖ ≤ 1 and |E| = E.
The added line under Corollary 3 reads roughly 'Supposons A mesurable/traçable' and is uncertain; the struck line reads 'Soit A ∈ b'.
